question: Which model has achieved the highest Accuracy score on the Story Cloze Test benchmark dataset?
pred_sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?model ?model_lbl (MAX(?accuracy) AS ?highest_accuracy)
WHERE {
  ?dataset       a                orkgc:Dataset;
                  rdfs:label       ?dataset_lbl.
  FILTER (str(?dataset_lbl) = "Story Cloze Test")
  ?benchmark      orkgp:HAS_DATASET       ?dataset;
                  orkgp:HAS_EVALUATION    ?eval.
  ?eval           orkgp:HAS_VALUE         ?accuracy.
  ?cont         orkgp:HAS_BENCHMARK      ?benchmark.
  ?cont      orkgp:HAS_MODEL          ?model.
  ?model      rdfs:label               ?model_lbl.
}
ORDER BY DESC(?highest_accuracy)
LIMIT 1
